why.evolution and setup: Wailmer→Wailord (Whale Pump needs four Energy), Carvanha→Mega Sharpedo ex and Baltoy→Claydol, with Wallace and Elegant Cape (Stage 1 +30 HP), must be built over several turns.
why.Bench preparation: Wailord and Mega Sharpedo ex are charged and caped on the Bench, and Turbo Shark attaches zone Water to a Benched Water Pokémon.
why.control and combinations: Claydol's Heal Block, Cyrus, Sabrina, Heavy Helmet and Big Malasada shape the board rather than just hit.

why.evolution and setup: Every attacker is a Stage 1 (Wailord, Mega Sharpedo ex, Alolan Muk, Claydol) built from Basics, plus Wallace, and Wailmer needs three Water.
why.Bench preparation: Mega Sharpedo ex and Wailord wait charged on the Bench; Turbo Shark charges Benched Water Pokémon.
why.control and combinations: Alolan Muk's Power of Alchemy removes Basic Abilities, Claydol blocks healing, and Sabrina/Cyrus/X Speed choose the Active Pokémon.

why.evolution and setup: Two Wallace evolve Carvanha and Goldeen straight from the deck into Mega Sharpedo ex and Seaking, and Wailord/Claydol are Stage 1s needing setup.
why.Bench preparation: Turbo Shark attaches Water to a Benched Water Pokémon, and Seaking's Aqua Bullet damages the opponent's Bench for later Cyrus targets.
why.control and combinations: Claydol's Heal Block, Sabrina, Cyrus, Heavy Helmet and Big Malasada control what is Active and what can heal.

why.evolution and setup: Flygon ex is a Stage 2 reached by two Rare Candy from Trapinch, and Dratini→Dragonair supports it.
why.Bench preparation: Flygon ex is charged on the Bench while Goomy holds the Active spot, and Dragonair's Dragon's Blessing works only from the Bench.
why.control and combinations: Goomy's Sticky Membrane taxes attacks, X Speed/Dragon's Blessing combine to power Flygon, Sand Slammer spreads damage and Cyrus pulls damaged targets.
Celesteela's Ultra Thrusters swaps Ultra Beasts around Big Beat's no-repeat lock, and Sabrina, Cyrus, Field Blower and two Stadiums manipulate the board.
why.Bench preparation: Buzzwole ex (Big Beat needs three Energy) charges on the Bench behind Celesteela, with Leaf Cape's +30 HP.
why.sacrifice and recovery: Lusamine works only after the opponent scores and returns discarded Energy to an Ultra Beast; low-HP Pheromosa soaks hits while the ex charges.
